title: The hush beneath the ice
description: Long slick runs build momentum; small rock islands set up each precision launch. Extreme edition: tenfold machinery, spike-lined catches and compressed timing.

rooms.name: The first frozen run
rooms.lesson: Ice carries momentum · stop on the dark stone. Let the cutter finish its sweep before crossing.

rooms.name: The frozen viaduct
rooms.lesson: The long icy walks demand early braking. Let the cutter finish its sweep before crossing.

rooms.name: The braking bowls
rooms.lesson: Plan your stop before the end of each ice run. Let the cutter finish its sweep before crossing.

rooms.name: The icefall tower
rooms.lesson: Use stone ledges to reset before the next icy crossing. Let the cutter finish its sweep before crossing.

rooms.name: The long frozen bends
rooms.lesson: Short corrections beat a late full launch. Let the cutter finish its sweep before crossing.

rooms.name: The last thawless mile
rooms.lesson: Hold your line across the final frozen runs. Let the cutter finish its sweep before crossing.
